verdict.rationale: Northwest Registered Agent is an online business-formation and registered-agent service that holds customer data, so asking whether users can choose a data-storage region is a fair question. The evidence pack has nothing on data residency. The only probe was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge, and the single community comment is about search visibility, not data storage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
